dimensions.evidence: Actual x86-64 GCC/Clang sizes: ORXValue8, handle2, cell20, entry5, lease32, heap336, intern56, ticket16 bytes. Native bridge support requires the declared IEEE binary64 object format; wire values contain no host pointer.
Eight genuine typed cells and identity entries, four central foreign leases,0..16 int32 buckets. T66 physically reserves64 bytes per allocator row even when the requested bucket count is4 or8.

External roots and pins retain graph reachability. Dead identity generations1..3 advance and retire at4; lease generations independently retire. Collection epoch255 stops instead of wrapping. Weak entries never extend object lifetime.

One controller owns metadata. A worker only reads the pinned span; packing never rewrites pinned bytes, including identical values. Lookup copies payloads; native double accesses use unsigned char lvalues under explicit format assumptions.

Real T66 allocation observations for1..8 distinct symbols show requested capacities4/8/16, attempts1/2/3, one live bucket row after publication and peak two rows during growth. A private row unwinds if the separate typed pool is full.

The pool stages8 typed cells during packing, reserves pinned positions and updates only identity locations. Strings copy at most15 bytes. Rehash copies encoded handles rather than payload strings; logical handle copies do not automatically retain roots.

Collection clears dead cells and advances generations. Intern close releases bucket storage only; caller roots remain separate. Cancel retains the foreign pin; join plus explicit finish releases it and invalidates the ticket.

Allocator take/release and actual T66 OwPin operations are explicit component calls. Hash collision handling compares full bytes. Native bridge performs format/order admission before character copying. No collector or hash library supplies the studied operations.

The actual separately compiled pthread backend reads the retained span across controller cancellation, collection and packing of other cells. Seven-profile semantic campaign includes GCC TSan. No arbitrary concurrent controller access or nonreturning-backend progress is guaranteed.

10,768 independent storage rows plus real cancellation and ten compiled semantic mutants cover finite collision/failure/movement/authority witnesses. Failures preserve public state and outputs except disclosed allocator diagnostics; epoch, identity, lease and root saturation are explicit finite-resource failures.

Six actual GCC/Clang O0/O2/O3 configurations separately compile every translation unit, with exact commands, disassembly and per-unit stack reports. No incremental-build or language-level safety equivalence is inferred.

At O2, whole probe image text/data/BSS: GCC26017/632/8, Clang29739/608/8. Decode/collect/pack/foreign-begin/intern-get local frames: GCC8/56/256/112/128 and Clang0/48/104/88/88 bytes. Linked baseline/dependency code is included; deeper callees and thread-stack reservations are additional.

168 retained samples plus24 discarded first samples time1000 packing operations at four pin masks on six compiler configurations; setup and finish excluded, timer overhead included. Report exact distributions rather than a worst-case latency or universal speed claim. No physical capability target or independent learner assessment was performed.
